title: Reboot the SRU process for the rabbitmq port fix series, starting with simplifying the fix in resolute
description:
Reboot the SRU process for the rabbitmq port fix series, starting with simplifying the fix in resolute

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~lvoytek/+archive/ubuntu/rabbitmq-server-fixes
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 48ad18d..f636a6f 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+rabbitmq-server (4.0.5-10ubuntu5.1) resolute; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rabbitmq-server.postinst: Simplify check for active rabbitmq service by
+    only running service rabbitmq-server status (LP: #2168867).
+
+ -- Lena Voytek <lena.voytek@canonical.com>  Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:45:11 -0400
+
 rabbitmq-server (4.0.5-10ubuntu5) resolute; urgency=medium
 
   * d/rabbitmq-server.postinst: Fix port warning message displaying
diff --git a/debian/rabbitmq-server.postinst b/debian/rabbitmq-server.postinst
index 218892c..a12f57e 100644
--- a/debian/rabbitmq-server.postinst
+++ b/debian/rabbitmq-server.postinst
@@ -33,18 +33,9 @@ if [ "$1" = "configure" ] || [ "$1" = "reconfigure" ] ; then
 
     # Check if MQ server port is already taken by another package.
     # If so, warn the user
-    if ss -ltn | grep -q ':5672 '; then
-        if [ ""$(ps --no-headers -o comm 1) = "systemd" ] ; then
-            if ! systemctl is-active --quiet rabbitmq-server.service; then
-                echo "WARNING: port 5672 is already in use by another application."
-                echo "RabbitMQ server will not be started automatically."
-            fi
-        else
-            if ! service rabbitmq-server status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-                echo "WARNING: port 5672 is already in use by another application."
-                echo "RabbitMQ server will not be started automatically."
-            fi
-        fi
+    if ss -ltn | grep -q ':5672 ' && ! service rabbitmq-server status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+        echo "WARNING: port 5672 is already in use by another application."
+        echo "RabbitMQ server will not be started automatically."
     fi
 
 	# We generate the erlang cookie by ourselves, just to make sure we don't
